clues: This town sits where a great bay meets the sea. It lies in the south-east of its state.
The bay and the sea soften the winter cold in this place. It is the farthest north on the east coast where many warm-land plants still grow well.
English settlers first came ashore at a cape near here, on their way to build Jamestown. The city of today was set up in 1906.
A famed book of world records lists this city for the longest pleasure shore in the whole world. No other resort shore on Earth runs longer.
A huge bridge and tunnel in one crosses the bay mouth at the south end of this city. It was the longest such link in the world until 2018.
